part.text:
Fixed in `compat/src/render.js`. The issue was that when `onChange` is renamed to `oninput` for input/textarea elements, it clobbered (or was clobbered by) an existing `onInput` handler, since Preact core keeps only one listener per DOM event (`src/diff/props.js:93`).

The fix makes compat merge the two handlers into a single wrapper (matching React, which fires both on every keystroke), covering all prop orders:
1. `onChange` renamed after an existing `oninput` → wrap in-loop (compat/src/render.js:165)
2. `oninput`/`onInput` appearing after a renamed `onChange` → wrap in-loop (compat/src/render.js:180)
3. camelCase `onInput` seen *before* `onChange` → post-loop merge that collapses `onInput` into `oninput` (compat/src/render.js:214)

- `should call onChange and onInput when input event is dispatched` — passes in both prop orders (was the failing FAIL_TO_PASS case)
- Full karma suite: 968 passed, 1 failed — the only failure (`should use capturing for event props ending with *Capture`) also fails on the clean tree, so it's pre-existing and unrelated
